title: Follow the Electricity Retail Code's rules on advertising prices
what: An electricity retailer advertising prices to small customers must meet the Code's requirements, including on conditional discounts.

laws.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Code—Electricity Retail) Regulations 2019

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Code—Electricity Retail) Regulations 2019
sources.quote: 14 Advertising conditional discounts (1) An electricity retailer must not advertise prices for supplying electricity in a distribution region to small customers if: (a) the advertisement mentions a conditional discount in relation to the prices; and (b) the advertisement does not meet the requirements of subsections (2) and (3).

reach.condition: if it retails electricity to small customers in a covered distribution region
